text: Selçuk, Türkiye near the ancient Roman city of Ephesus. In the New Testament of the Bible you find the apostle Paul’s Epistle to the Ephesians – that is the people of this city. In the picture you see what’s left of the Temple of Artemis in the front, a Byzantine fort in the back, and the Isa Bey mosque built during Seljuk rule in the middle. We did a 15 minute detour so I could take this picture of 2,000 years of stonework, but my wife wasn’t impressed.
